scripts.lint: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); function check(d){ for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes: true})){ const p = d + '/' + f.name; if(f.isDirectory()) check(p); else if(f.name.endsWith('.js')) cp.execSync('node --check ' + p); } } check('src'); check('tests'); console.log('All JavaScript files syntax verified successfully.');"
